entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Are you serious?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I told you that the story about my[n]sick little sister was a lie...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You know you're being used for money...[n]and you still request me?
It's fun.[clr 27]
I want to know more.
Who's the Master here?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Are you... an extreme[n]masochist or something?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Huh...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: What good would that do?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, I am thankful that you're[n]requesting me, but...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You really are one strange kid...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm a mediocre teacher and[n]a mediocre maid...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: And yet, you listen to everything[n]I have to say...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...You're the complete opposite of me.[n]I don't even properly attend to my[n]students' needs.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: The money is actually...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...An "apology."

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: There was a student named Takase at[n]the school I taught at before Shujin.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Takase-kun was considered a problem [n]child, since he had the lowest grades [n]and skipped school a lot.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So I was put in charge of guiding him...[n]or rather, pushing him to transfer to[n]another school.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But when I got to know him, [n]I realized that he wasn't [n]a problem child after all.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...In fact, he was working several[n]part-time jobs just so he could[n]cover his living expenses.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: His relatives took him in when his[n]parents died, so he had to make[n]money to support himself.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: He couldn't attend school every day,[n]but he was motivated to study.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That's why I decided to tutor him.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: After I started working with him,[n]his grades started to improve, [n]slowly but surely.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But I was told that it was wrong to only[n]help certain students and not others...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Then a strange rumor about him being a[n]juvenile delinquent began to circulate.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: And on top of that, I got called into[n]the principal's office...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: He threatened me... saying that[n]I'd be dismissed if I continued[n]to tutor Takase-kun.
How terrible...[clr 27]
It was inevitable.
So, did you stop?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But you could say the same about me.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Yeah, that's true, but...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: What I did after that was even worse...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: If only I had stuck to my convictions...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But I...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I got scared... of losing my job, and[n]of having rumors spread about me.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So... I canceled our upcoming[n]tutoring sessions...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Takase-kun was on his way to one of[n]his part-time jobs when I told him...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Out of all days, it was New Year's Eve,[n]and it had been pouring rain all day...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: And... he died in a car crash.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: He sounded so depressed when I told[n]him that I couldn't tutor him anymore...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But then he said that it was no big deal[n]because he had to work anyway,[n]so I wouldn't feel bad.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: If only I had kept my promise to him...
It's not your fault.
It was bad luck.
It's no one's fault.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Takase-kun was exhausted from the[n]tutoring sessions and working at all[n]his part-time jobs...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: His guardians blamed me for the[n]accident, saying it was all my fault[n]that he was so tired...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: They said that they were going to sue[n]me and take the issue to the media and[n]Board of Education.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I wouldn't have been accused of a crime,[n]but if word had gotten out, the school[n]would've been done for.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...I wanted to continue teaching,[n]no matter what.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So I ended up paying them the "apology"[n]money so they wouldn't sue me or[n]say anything.
You okay with that?
Guardians, huh...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It was my indecisiveness that backed[n]him into a corner, and I blame myself[n]every day.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I know paying them isn't going to bring[n]him back, but it's the only way I can[n]atone for my sins.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It seems like his guardians are satisfied[n]with our arrangement, so...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...See? Nothing good ever comes[n]from getting involved with me.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I have to keep my distance to avoid[n]hurting others, so I don't meddle in[n]my students' lives.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I've been coming here because of a[n]random twist of fate, but we should[n]say goodbye as well.
It's too late now.
What about our deal?
I want to see you again.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: [lName]-kun...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You're really not the type to back down,[n]are you?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Haha... I guess we're in this together,[n]now that I told you the whole story,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'll see what I can do about the other[n]teachers so you get free periods with[n]them, too.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...I look forward to continuing our[n]relationship.
I feel like my relationship with[n]Kawakami has deepened...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: All righty, time to clean. I'm going to put[n]more energy into it than usual today! [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: *cough* *cough*

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh my, this room is sooo dusty!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Even though I wipe the place squeaky[n]clean every visit...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, I guess it's all for you, Master.[n]I'll work hard to earn my keep! [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: *cough* *cough*

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, uh, wooow! It's so dusty! If my[n]cough is already this bad...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Maybe we'd be better off tearing this[n]place down than trying to clean it?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, the shabbi— I mean, chicness of[n]this room is truly its charm, so let's[n]keep it as is!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: All right, I have to go. [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'll be eagerly awaiting your next[n]request, Master! [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]
